Our Story
A Store Built
by Collectors

Founded in San Antonio, Texas, Umoja — meaning "unity" in Swahili — began in the late '90s with a group of friends grinding on EverQuest and Counter-Strike. Driven by a passion for gaming and community, we built lifelong connections across multiple platforms. Now, we're bringing that exact same energy to the hobby world.

What started as a blueprint is now a reality: the hobby store we always wanted to shop at. We aren't a massive corporate retailer with a sterile warehouse; we're collectors who love the hobby and treat fellow collectors right. Beyond carrying major trading card brands, we specialize in a diverse curation of treasures — including Hot Wheels, figures, Funkos, and exclusive, limited-edition releases.

Launched online in 2026, every order we ship is packed with care, and every customer gets a real answer. This is just the beginning of our journey — look out for the Umoja Treasures brick-and-mortar experience coming in 2028.

Delivery & Fulfillment
Shipping Policy

We pack every order by hand with collector-grade protection and ship from our San Antonio, TX and Kansas locations. Here's everything you need to know about how your treasures get to your door.

🚚
Free Standard Shipping

Enjoy free standard shipping on any order over $300. Club members threshold is $150. Orders under $300 or $150 for club members will ship at a standard UPS/USPS rate which is calculated during checkout.

⏱️
Processing Time

Orders are processed within 1–5 days. Orders placed on weekends will be processed the following 1–2 business days.

Pre-Orders will be shipped within 1–2 days of release. Any releases on Friday or the weekend will be shipped the following Monday.

📦
Carefully Packed

Singles are always shipped with a penny sleeve and toploaded inside a bubble mailer with a cardboard surrounding.

Slabs are always shipped in a box with ample padding.

Sealed product is always shipped in a box with ample padding to guarantee secure arrival.

Delivery Estimates

Standard (UPS Ground/USPS Priority)3–6 business days
Expedited (Priority Mail)2–3 business days
Express (Priority Express)1–2 business days

Delivery estimates begin once your order has shipped and exclude processing time. Transit times are estimates provided by the carrier and are not guaranteed.

Tracking, Returns & More

◆ Order Tracking

You'll receive a tracking number by email as soon as your order ships. Members can also track orders from their account dashboard.

◆ Pre-Orders

Pre-order items ship as soon as they're released. If your order contains both in-stock and pre-order items, we'll ship everything together on the release date. Split shipping is not available. This may be updated in the future.

◆ Lost or Damaged Packages

All orders that meet the free shipping thresholds are insured. Anything under the threshold will require the customer to select insurance. UTC is not responsible for missing or damaged packages on arrival. That being said we will always do our best for such inquiries.

◆ Return Policy

UTC has a no returns or exchanges policy. All products have a 100% guarantee of Authenticity.

Questions about your order?

Our team is happy to help with anything shipping-related.
